{{Quote|My past may not be at risk, but my family honor surely is, ''[&hellip;]'' Regardless, I cannot betray my Queen in such a way.|Trevik|translated=1|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
The [[Quesoth]] [[Gender/Legends|males]] who resided in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]'s [[Red City]], [[Jirvin]] and [[Trevik]], were part of a '''family'''<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. During the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Trevik became the reigning [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|Queen of the Red's]] [[bowlcarrier]], the highest honor a member of the [[Midli]] caste could achieve, carrying a bowl of [[Nectar/Legends|nectar]] for her. The bowlcarrier's brother told the other to use a [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]] provided by [[Empire of the Hand]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] to record the artwork inside [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s quarters in the [[Dwelling of Guests]] building under the warlord's directive in an attempt to trick the [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] into [[Attack on the Red City|attacking]] the [[City/Legends|city]] as the alien desired.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

Trevik complied, and did as ordered after hesitating, as he did not wish to damage his family's honor. Shortly after, a battle between Thrawn's [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and Esva's [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|warriors]]&mdash;the Chosen&mdash;and the [[Quesoth Soldier]]s broken, with the warlord being [[Death/Legends|killed]] after telling the bowlcarrier to tell Thrawn that although he was defeated, his warriors would kill the Chiss.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The family appeared in the [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and included in ''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
